messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Open Stan Algorithms Requests
parts:
I've started adding algorithms on the to-do list to the issue tracker, https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues?labels=algorithm&page=1&state=open.

These are meant to be high level issues that define the future of Stan as a package for Bayesian inference. Before an algorithm can be implemented it has to be sufficiently well-defined that all dependencies can reduced to a series of individual feature issues that can be tackled one at a time.
